_note: Aion-time: the aeon doctrine (CW9ii's foreword and the Aquarius passage, CW10 ¶589), enantiodromia as the law that everything that runs high turns (CW6 ¶708-709, CW11 ¶526, CW13 ¶294, CW7 ¶111), the quality of the moment (CW15 ¶82, the 1932 seminar on fate and time), the world clock (CW12 ¶307) and the eternal return (Nietzsche seminar). Van Eenwyk carries the section where the concept names a dynamical system. Quotations are placed by the corpus; nothing is typed.
line: Passages on the aeon, enantiodromia, the quality of the moment, kairos and chronos, the world clock and the eternal return, with two statements of Van Eenwyk's.

sections.title: The aeon
sections.line: Aion (CW9ii, 1951), its foreword and ¶136, and Flying Saucers (CW10 ¶589, 1958): the Pisces aeon, and the spring-point's entry into Aquarius.

quotes.quote: the Pisces aeon is the synchronistic concomitant of two thousand years of Christian development.
filled with intimations of a kind of enantiodromian reversal of dominants. I mean by this the dilemma of Christ and Antichrist
spring-point will have moved from its present position 18 degrees into Aquarius, the next aeon, that of the Water Carrier.
We are now nearing that great change which may be expected when the spring-point enters Aquarius

sections.title: Enantiodromia
sections.line: CW6 ¶708–709, where Jung defines the term (Psychological Types, Definitions); CW13 ¶294, CW7 ¶111 and CW11 ¶526, where he uses it.

quotes.quote: it is used to designate the play of opposites in the course of events—the view that everything that exists turns into its opposite.
I use the term enantiodromia for the emergence of the unconscious opposite in the course of time
every psychic development, whether individual or collective, possesses an optimum which, when exceeded, produces an enantiodromia, that is, turns into its opposite
discovered the most marvellous of all psychological laws: the regulative function of opposites

What we observe here is a fundamental law of life—enantiodromia or conversion into the opposite; and it is this that makes possible the reunion of the warring halves of the personality and thereby brings the civil war to an end.

sections.title: The quality of the moment
sections.line: Jung on time: the quality of a moment (CW15 ¶82, Richard Wilhelm: In Memoriam, 1930), kairos (CW10 ¶398), time and energy (the seminars of 4 December 1929 and 8 June 1932) and the unconscious's space-time continuum (CW9ii ¶45).

quotes.quote: whatever is born or done at this particular moment of time has the quality of this moment of time
it is rather the fault of kairos— the present moment in time—whose name on closer investigation turns out to be Wotan.
Time is the essential identity with creative energy. There is a Greek aphorism, "Wherever there is creation, there is time." Chronos was the god of light, creation, and time.
Fate evolves with time, and it is identical with time.

Fate and time are absolutely identical, fate being the more human aspect and time the more energic aspect. And time is another aspect of energy, for without time there is no energy, and without energy there is no time. Time is measured energy
finds itself in the psychically relative space-time continuum that is characteristic of the unconscious as such

sections.title: The world clock
sections.line: CW12 ¶307 (Psychology and Alchemy, Part II, the Vision of the World Clock) and the Zarathustra seminar's statement on the eternal return (pdf p1375).

quotes.quote: There is a vertical and a horizontal circle, having a common centre. This is the world clock
It is a circle, the eternal return. That is probably the historical origin of the idea of the apokatastasis, but that life is a circle is psychologically an archetypal idea

sections.title: The turn as a system
sections.line: Van Eenwyk, Archetypes and Strange Attractors (1997): two sentences from his account of chaos and order; the words are his, not Jung's.

quotes.quote: designates not only where a dynamic becomes unstable, but where it becomes stable as well
order is never pure. Like the yin and the yang, it carries within it the potential to turn into its opposite. The same is true for chaos
